lines.text: Rachel wore her warm gloves on the whole steep climb.
Her hands sweated, and at the windy summit the gloves were damp and her fingers went numb.
Climb in thin liner gloves, or none if you're warm.
Keep a dry, warm pair in a plastic bag in your pack,
and put them on at the top before you cool down.
Her hands stayed warm all the way down.
Save this before your next cold hike.
